sentences.en: These flowers are not only beautiful but also fragrant.
sentences.zh: 这些花朵不仅美丽，而且香气扑鼻。

sentences.en: The garden is fragrant with the smell of roses.
sentences.zh: 花园里弥漫着玫瑰的芳香。

sentences.en: The toaster-oven's timer rings. The fragrant smell of well toasted bread.
sentences.zh: 烤箱定时器响起。新鲜吐司散发出诱人的香味。

senses.zh: 芳香的，香的；令人愉快的，使人感到愉快的
